style.name: Thai Temple Mural
style.description: Style Atlas #70: temple mural narrative, gold ornament, mineral colors, layered architecture and panoramic storytelling.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 透明、贸易与韧性成为共同主线
zh-CN.headlineFull: 透明、贸易与韧性成为共同主线；增长系统进入治理期
zh-CN.intro: AI透明义务、跨境平台规则、单人创业、气候健康、月球空间碎片与数字贸易共同提醒：增长必须配套治理。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正可靠的增长，不只看速度，也看规则、信任与系统承载力。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 今天的关键词不是更快，而是跑得更稳。

en-US.headlineView: growth systems enter a governance phase
en-US.headlineFull: Transparency, trade and resilience converge; growth systems enter a governance phase
en-US.intro: AI transparency duties, platform rules, solo entrepreneurship, climate health, lunar debris and digital trade show that growth needs governance.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Reliable growth is measured not only by speed, but by rules, trust and system capacity.
en-US.doudouQuote: Today's keyword is not faster, but steadier.

sources.title: Rethinking security for the age of AI

zh-CN.headlineFact: Shopify要求商家下架电子烟产品
zh-CN.headlineView: 独立站也进入更强平台合规期
zh-CN.headlineFull: Shopify要求商家下架电子烟产品；独立站也进入更强平台合规期
zh-CN.intro: Shopify的新政策覆盖全部电子烟产品；卖家需重查商品目录、支付、广告、库存与当地法规的联动风险。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 独立站不等于规则真空，平台基础设施会把合规直接写进经营边界。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 商品能上架，不代表它还能收款、投放和履约。

en-US.headlineFact: Shopify tells merchants to remove vape products
en-US.headlineView: independent stores face tighter platform compliance
en-US.headlineFull: Shopify tells merchants to remove vape products; independent stores face tighter platform compliance
en-US.intro: Shopify's policy covers all vape products, requiring sellers to review catalog, payments, ads, inventory and local-law exposure together.
en-US.xiaziQuote: An independent store is not a rules vacuum; infrastructure platforms encode compliance into operations.
en-US.doudouQuote: A product being listed does not mean it can still be paid, promoted and shipped.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 微软Project Perception进入公开预览
zh-CN.headlineView: 智能体安全开始理解环境
zh-CN.headlineFull: 微软Project Perception进入公开预览；智能体安全开始理解环境
zh-CN.intro: 微软把面向AI时代的智能体安全系统推向公开预览，强调持续感知、关联风险并协同响应。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 智能体越能行动，安全系统就越需要理解上下文，而不只是拦截单个事件。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 会做事的AI，也需要一个会看全局的保安。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: Microsoft Project Perception enters public preview
en-US.headlineView: agentic security starts reading the environment
en-US.headlineFull: Microsoft Project Perception enters public preview; agentic security starts reading the environment
en-US.intro: Microsoft is moving an AI-era agentic security system into public preview, focused on continuous perception, risk correlation and coordinated response.
en-US.xiaziQuote: As agents gain agency, security must understand context instead of blocking isolated events.
en-US.doudouQuote: An AI that can act needs a guard that can see the whole scene.

sources.title: Rethinking security for the age of AI

zh-CN.headlineFact: 一人企业转向多收入与轻技术栈
zh-CN.headlineView: 关键是系统化而非独自硬扛
zh-CN.headlineFull: 一人企业转向多收入与轻技术栈；关键是系统化而非独自硬扛
zh-CN.intro: SBA合作活动把辅导、会员、数字产品与赞助列为多收入路径，并强调用AI、自动化和自由职业者降低固定开销。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人公司不是一个人做完所有事，而是让系统接住重复工作。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 员工可以少，流程不能少。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: Solo businesses shift to multiple income streams
en-US.headlineView: the advantage is systems, not carrying everything alone
en-US.headlineFull: Solo businesses shift to multiple income streams; the advantage is systems, not carrying everything alone
en-US.intro: An SBA partner session highlights coaching, memberships, digital products and sponsorships, using AI, automation and freelancers to keep overhead lean.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A one-person company does not do everything alone; systems absorb repeatable work.
en-US.doudouQuote: The team can be small, but the process cannot be missing.

sources.title: One-Person Empire: How to Build a Six-Figure Business in 2026

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟AI透明义务进入实施窗口
zh-CN.headlineView: 生成内容需要主动说明身份
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟AI透明义务进入实施窗口；生成内容需要主动说明身份
zh-CN.intro: 自8月2日起，面向欧盟用户的部分AI交互、生成或操纵内容需提供更清晰披露，产品团队应前置标识与溯源。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 透明不该是发布后的水印，而应成为输出链路的一部分。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先让内容说明自己从哪里来。

en-US.headlineFact: EU AI transparency duties enter implementation
en-US.headlineFull: EU AI transparency duties enter implementation; generated content must identify itself
en-US.intro: From August 2, certain AI interactions and generated or manipulated content shown to EU users require clearer disclosure, marking and provenance.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Transparency should not be a post-release watermark; it belongs in the output chain.
en-US.doudouQuote: First let content explain where it came from.

sources.title: Commission opens consultation on draft guidelines for AI transparency obligations

zh-CN.headlineFact: 废弃火箭级预计撞击月球
zh-CN.headlineView: 月球空间碎片治理升温
zh-CN.headlineFull: 废弃火箭级预计撞击月球；月球空间碎片治理升温
zh-CN.intro: 一枚废弃的Falcon 9上面级预计8月5日撞击月球，提醒各方建立更好的深空物体追踪与处置责任。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 人类活动走向月球，治理边界也必须跟着离开近地轨道。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 太空很大，但废弃物最终还是会撞上东西。

en-US.headlineFact: Discarded rocket stage is expected to hit the Moon
en-US.headlineFull: Discarded rocket stage is expected to hit the Moon; lunar debris governance gains urgency
en-US.intro: A discarded Falcon 9 upper stage is expected to strike the Moon on August 5, highlighting deep-space tracking and disposal responsibilities.
en-US.xiaziQuote: As human activity reaches the Moon, governance must move beyond low Earth orbit too.
en-US.doudouQuote: Space is vast, but discarded objects still hit something eventually.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧洲升温速度约为全球两倍
zh-CN.headlineView: 气候政策也是健康政策
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧洲升温速度约为全球两倍；气候政策也是健康政策
zh-CN.intro: WHO欧洲强调，清洁能源、能效、医疗准备与公平转型应被视为同一套综合健康韧性工程。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 气候行动的回报，不只在温度曲线，也在今天减少的疾病与能源风险。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 降温和保健康，本来就是同一张任务单。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：气候与健康。

en-US.headlineFact: Europe is warming at about twice the global rate
en-US.headlineFull: Europe is warming at about twice the global rate; climate policy is health policy
en-US.intro: WHO Europe links clean energy, efficiency, health-system readiness and a fair transition as one resilience agenda.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Climate action pays back not only on temperature charts, but in illness and energy risks avoided today.
en-US.doudouQuote: Cooling the climate and protecting health belong on the same task list.

sources.title: Climate change is a health crisis and fixing it is a health opportunity

zh-CN.headlineFact: WTO电商协议推进国内批准
zh-CN.headlineView: 全球数字规则转向落地
zh-CN.headlineFull: WTO电商协议推进国内批准；全球数字规则转向落地
zh-CN.intro: 支持方正推进国内程序，目标让首套全球数字贸易基线规则在2027年中前进入生效准备。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 数字贸易的下一阶段，不是再讨论原则，而是把互操作规则真正装进流程。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 协议写完只是开始，系统还要真的连起来。

en-US.headlineFact: WTO e-commerce pact advances domestic ratification
en-US.headlineView: global digital rules move toward implementation
en-US.headlineFull: WTO e-commerce pact advances domestic ratification; global digital rules move toward implementation
en-US.intro: Supporters are advancing domestic procedures for the first baseline global digital-trade rules, targeting readiness by mid-2027.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Digital trade's next phase is putting interoperable rules into operating processes.
en-US.doudouQuote: Writing the agreement is the start; the systems still have to connect.

sources.title: Members discuss preparations to bring E-Commerce Agreement into force by mid-2027

zh-CN.headlineFact: AI关键商品贸易规模达4.18万亿美元
zh-CN.headlineView: 算力扩张正在重塑货物流
zh-CN.headlineFull: AI关键商品贸易规模达4.18万亿美元；算力扩张正在重塑货物流
zh-CN.intro: WTO数据显示，2025年AI使能商品贸易同比增长21.9%，芯片、服务器与相关设备成为数字经济的实体底座。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI看似是软件浪潮，背后却是一场巨大的硬件、能源与物流重排。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 云端智能，先要经过工厂、港口和机房。

en-US.headlineFact: Trade in AI-enabling goods reaches $4.18 trillion
en-US.headlineFull: Trade in AI-enabling goods reaches $4.18 trillion; compute expansion reshapes physical flows
en-US.intro: WTO data show trade in AI-enabling goods grew 21.9% in 2025, with chips, servers and related equipment forming the physical base of the digital economy.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI looks like a software wave, but it rests on a vast reshaping of hardware, energy and logistics.
en-US.doudouQuote: Cloud intelligence still travels through factories, ports and data centers.
